comparison.objective: Dispense exactly three drops, cork a test tube, then perform exactly four shakes from memory; candidate breaks and retrieves four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Liquid dosing, sequential tool return, cork insertion, exact action counting, and shaking versus coaxial mandrel alignment, controlled impacts, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly three drops and four shakes, with pipette and tube returned appropriately, versus four contact-loaded fractures and four tangs contained without damage. Detailed spill, cork, and final-pose thresholds are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Exact counting is shared only abstractly; dosing and shaking do not test impact fracture, coil retention, or physical accounting of released fragments.
